title: 指引上调：股价却跌，市场在担心什么？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's start off with the guidance going forward. You raised it ever so slightly, but clearly investors were pleased with that.
segments.zh: 我们先从未来的业绩指引说起。你略微上调了指引，显然市场参与者对此感到满意。

segments.en: What gives you the confidence that you're going to meet those numbers? Yeah, but first, thank you for inviting me here to this show.
segments.zh: 是什么让你有信心实现这些目标？首先，感谢你邀请我参加这个节目。

segments.en: And I'm definitely pleased with the quarter. We had a strong beat in the quarter.
segments.zh: 我对这个季度的表现非常满意，我们实现了强劲的业绩超预期。

segments.en: We raised the second half of the year. So I think that's what you see that our investors were pleased with.
segments.zh: 我们上调了今年下半年的预期，所以我想这就是市场参与者感到满意的地方。

segments.en: We have had a fantastic performance over the last six months where our stock is up almost 50%.
segments.zh: 过去六个月我们表现出色，股价上涨了近50%。

segments.en: But it really speaks to that the strategy is working.
segments.zh: 这确实说明我们的战略正在奏效。

segments.en: The strategy of becoming the infrastructure behind the genomic medicine.
segments.zh: 即成为基因组医学背后的基础设施。

segments.en: And really providing sequences, regions, and of course also compute and software into
segments.zh: 真正提供测序、区域，当然还有计算和软件，

segments.en: many laboratories around the world where they can take that and take the biological sample and translate that into deep insights.
segments.zh: 提供给世界各地的许多实验室，让他们利用这些工具处理生物样本，并将其转化为深度见解。

segments.en: That goes both for researchers' pharma, but more importantly, also into clinical apps.
segments.zh: 这既适用于研究型制药公司，更重要的是，也适用于临床应用。

segments.en: Clinical apps are really adopting sequencing DNA sequencing now to help really ensure that their patients can get a good profiling of their diseases.
segments.zh: 临床应用正积极采用DNA测序，以确保患者能获得良好的疾病分析。

segments.en: On college, it's a big one. And we are seeing a lot of momentum in that space.
segments.zh: 在肿瘤领域，这是一个重要应用，我们看到了很多进展。

segments.en: Well, somebody who has some personal experience with that, I talked to me a little bit more about the clinical side of the business, how much of a growth story that can be, but also the efficacy of the information that is being produced on the spot there.
segments.zh: 嗯，有人有相关经验，请多谈谈临床业务，它有多大的增长潜力，以及现场生成信息的有效性。
